School x has a value of $62 and priority rank 2.
School y has a value of $47 and priority rank 1.
School z has a value of $50 and priority rank 2.

Comparing schools with priority rank 1: y ($47) is better than w ($42).
Comparing schools with priority rank 2: x ($62) is better than z ($50).

Now, I need to decide between y and x. Even though y has higher priority, x has a significantly higher value ($62 vs $47). Therefore, I prefer x over y. Then I prefer y over z, and z over w.

So, my ranking should be x > y > z > w.
